verdict.line: You lose any extended trade where Riven opens with her W (Ki Burst) stun before level 6; you win once you've hit Fury of the Sands and can land Wither on her before she closes distance.

brief.thesis: Riven has a full stun-into-combo kit by level 3-5 and Nasus has nothing but a single-target poke until he stacks Q and hits 6, which is exactly why this reads as Riven lane advantage and Riven solo-kill advantage at a 37.3% Nasus win rate over 51 games despite Nasus running 51.2% overall in top lane. The matchup isn't close until Fury of the Sands comes online and Wither can actually land on her.

theirWindow.what: She'll open with W (Ki Burst) to stun, chain all three casts of Q (Broken Wings) for burst, and reposition with E (Valor). Disengage rather than trade face to face in this window.

yourWindow.when: After she burns Q and E
yourWindow.what: Her mobility is gone for several seconds once Broken Wings and Valor are both on cooldown. Step in, land W (Wither) to gut her attack and movement speed, then chase down free Q (Siphoning Strike) stacks.

start.why: Highest-performing start at 41.2% win rate and 51.5% pick rate; the sustain and damage reduction on autos let you survive her early poke while you farm Q stacks.

boots.why: Best measured win rate at 56.5%; the ability haste keeps Wither and Spirit Fire on a shorter rotation so you can punish her cooldown windows more often.

core.why: Most-picked core item (20.5%); gives the damage and move speed to actually catch her once Wither has her slowed.
Attack speed slow punishes her Runic Blade-fueled autos and takes pressure off your lane during her all-in windows.
Stacks with Soul Eater lifesteal to win extended trades once she's out of dashes.

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest pick rate page (41.2%) for this matchup; the heal and movement burst on cast let you absorb her poke and reposition out of her stun chain instead of dying to it.

summoners.why: Highest measured win rate of the three common pages (63.2%); Flash gets you out of her Ki Burst stun or Wind Slash angle, and Teleport lets you reset after losing an early trade and still come back to scale.

playing.title: Farm safe pre-6
playing.detail: Just land Q (Siphoning Strike) on the wave for stacks rather than trading face-to-face before level 6 — her stun-into-triple-Q combo wins any extended fight in this window.

playing.title: Track her Runic Blade stacks
playing.detail: Her passive charges on ability casts; a fully-stacked empowered auto glow means she's about to commit. Back off or pre-emptively threaten Wither.

playing.title: Wither the instant she commits
playing.detail: Land W (Wither) before she dashes in with Q (Broken Wings) or E (Valor). Once it's on her, her attack and movement speed craters and the combo falls apart.

playing.title: Zone the wave with Spirit Fire
playing.detail: Drop E (Spirit Fire) on the minions when she tries to contest farm — it still strips armor off anyone standing in it, turning her aggression into your damage.

playing.title: Pop R the moment she opens
playing.detail: Fury of the Sands' health drain is strongest when she's already committed to a stun chain; cast it as she opens W so the fight becomes attrition she can't win.

playing.title: Don't swing into her E block
playing.detail: Valor blocks incoming damage on a 10/9/8/7/6s cooldown. Hold your stacked Q swing until the block window expires instead of wasting it.

playing.title: Teleport back after losing prio
playing.detail: If she wins the early trades, Teleport resets you without losing more plates, buying time until your Q stacks and Trinity Force core come online.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, boots, runes, and summoner spells above are OP.GG's measured picks from real Nasus vs. Riven games on patch 16.20.1; the timings, trade windows, and reasoning behind each pick are our own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Keep your distance from Riven while paying close attention to her Conqueror stack count. Focus on farming with [Q] to stack up rather than engaging Riven. After reaching level 6, try to use Fury of the Sands [R] + Unsealed Spellbook to gain the upper hand.
